prompt: What were the top 5 Billboard songs by musical groups in the year 1985?
answer:
Using Billboard’s **1985 Year-End Hot 100** and treating duos as musical groups, the top five songs by groups were:

1. **“Careless Whisper” — Wham!** — No. 1  
2. **“Wake Me Up Before You Go-Go” — Wham!** — No. 3  
3. **“I Want to Know What Love Is” — Foreigner** — No. 4  
4. **“Out of Touch” — Daryl Hall John Oates** — No. 6  
5. **“Everybody Wants to Rule the World” — Tears for Fears** — No. 7  

If “musical groups” is intended to mean **full rock bands only**, excluding the duo Hall & Oates, then **“Money for Nothing” by Dire Straits**—No. 8 overall—would replace “Out of Touch.”
